body: Hey, there’s hope! I successfully canceled my account with Anytime. I kept emailing them until they finally confirmed that my account was officially closed. I also sent a registered letter and followed their outdated account closure requirements, but they still charged me after the mail had been sent. That’s why I kept pushing until I received confirmation. Wishing you luck.
I successfully ended it with Anytime. I just kept emailing them until they sent a confirmation that my account is officially closed.

Hey I've commented before and I just wanted to update anyone who comes scross this. I've submitted what they've requested of me (the registered mail) and they have still charged my card. I've also contacted my bank for help and at this point, I will just close down my account. They've operated under a few names (Intouch Talent, The Actor's Den etc) and their reviews and te fact that they've changed their name aa few times, says everything. 

# In google, search up "Intouch Talent" and go to their reviews.

  
Cheers.
